name: Fountain Coach Tennisrunde
writePolicy: tennis.write scope plus ChatGPT confirmation and server-side confirm: true
mcpAuthentication: OAuth authorization-code + PKCE with refresh tokens; GitHub, Google, or Apple upstream; static bearer remains an owner-only compatibility lane
notes: A URL makes the public discovery contract addressable; it does not grant ChatGPT permission to modify data. The MCP endpoint must be connected as a Custom App in ChatGPT.
OAuth admits only identities listed in TENNIS_ADMIN_EMAILS or OAUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS and requires explicit consent.
Write actions require tennis.write, an authenticated MCP app and user confirmation at the ChatGPT integration boundary.
Replace publicUrl during the owner-approved HTTPS deployment phase.
